title: 复习 + 模拟：从下飞机到出机场
en: Review: From Landing to Arrivals Hall
goal: 复习第 1–11 天的单词和句子；完整演练一遍：填入境卡 → 过移民局 → 取行李 → 过海关。
tips: 复习日不学新词。先把生词本里的词过一遍，再做复习测验。
角色扮演时，先看中文自己说一遍，再听示范对比。卡住的句子加到生词本。
目标：不看文字，只听声音，也能答出移民官和海关的每个问题。

dialogue.title: 全流程模拟：落地到出关

lines.en: Would you like an arrival card? Please fill it out before landing.
lines.zh: 您需要入境卡吗？请在落地前填好。

lines.en: Yes, please. Could I borrow a pen?
lines.zh: 要的，谢谢。能借我一支笔吗？

lines.en: Next, please. What's the purpose of your visit?
lines.zh: 下一位。来访目的是什么？

lines.en: How long will you be staying?
At the Grand Hotel in the city center.
Is this your first time here?
Please put your fingers on the scanner and look at the camera. OK. Enjoy your stay.
lines.zh: 请把手指放在扫描仪上，看摄像头。好了，祝你玩得愉快。

lines.en: Thank you. Excuse me, where is the baggage claim?
lines.zh: 谢谢。请问行李提取处在哪里？

lines.en: Go down the escalator. Check the screens for your carousel number.
lines.zh: 坐扶梯下去，看屏幕上的转盘号。

lines.en: Hello. Do you have anything to declare?
